# 3 bedroom terraced house for sale

> NO ONWARD CHAIN- GREAT VALUE!!! A fantastic opportunity to acquire this 3 Bedroom terraced home in a popular area of Taunton. Offered with no onward chain and presenting great potential as a home or rental investment. The ground floor provides spacious living accommodation with a lounge and kitchen/diner upstairs are three good sized bedrooms and family bathroom.
